headlines.title: Bay Area storm problems: Flooding, trees and power lines down
headlines.description: Despite the wind and rain, people lined up Wednesday morning to check out the first Vallarta Supermarket in the Bay Area. In the morning, crews struggled to keep pop-up tents in place as banners and line markers whipped around in the wind. People waiting in line told NBC Bay Area that braving the weather for the supermarket’s grand opening was about community. While people in San Jose were shopping for groceries, others in Campbell were shopping for storm supplies. A store manager said customers were picking up flashlights, batteries, tarps, propane and generators. People were also visiting sandbag stations as the storm could bring minor flooding. With an El Niño season, this won’t be the only storm with flood risks. Wind and rain could also bring down trees and power lines. Drivers are being urged to slow down and watch for hazards on the roads.
headlines.source: NBC Bay Area staff and Bay City News
